request: Enforce cumulative project assurance in CI and protect release provenance.
scope: Security scans, release evidence and independent approval.
setup: Run from the PARK checkout using Python and Git.
constraints: Keep scanning read-only and scope signed release evidence to the default branch.

steps.action: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.when: Run its assurance checks with synthetic scanner commands.
acceptance.then: Each required check runs for the selected tier.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.given: A required scanner fails or recovery evidence is stale.

acceptance.entrypoint: Run tier-dependent checks and verify release prerequisites.
acceptance.given: A critical project owner authors a pull request.
